results.rationale: Consistency: The overall wall/floor layout, cracks and two loose stones remain, but the surrounding wall texture and floor surface are both noticeably sharpened and darkened. Instruction: The central white opening becomes wider and loses much of its thick stone rim; a completed wall should close the opening with continuous stone. No closure is achieved. Quality: Structure and perspective are readable, but the large blank white cutout has an unnaturally flat, thin boundary and the surface texture is conspicuously harsh; these are visible artifacts.

Consistency: Cracks, floor layout and loose stones remain recognizable, but conspicuous triangular bright patches alter the wall lighting and the floor and wall textures become heavily mottled. Instruction: The jagged hole becomes a large roughly rectangular white opening instead of being filled with stone; the expected continuous completed wall is absent. Quality: The opening has a flat, implausibly smooth white interior, triangular illumination patches have abrupt boundaries, and wall/floor surfaces show distracting granular, faintly colored texture corruption. These multiple errors degrade naturalness and texture fidelity.
